description: Create an unpaid checkout link after the customer approves the current quote. Read it first with printing.quotes.get, since the customer can change delivery and speed in the quote panel, and only send option fields the customer asked for in chat. Charges nothing and places no order. The customer pays in Stripe Checkout, which only authorizes the card; AIURION captures after reviewing the model. The token works with AIURION only, never Stripe.

accessToken.description: Guest token from printing.sessions.start. Omit when it is sent as a Bearer header.

approvalConfirmed.description: True only after the customer approves this quote.

fulfillmentMethod.description: US shipping, SoMa pickup or Bay Area courier.

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse the same key on retries.

materialId.description: Material ID from printing.capabilities.get. Defaults to black_pla. Changing it reprices the quote and needs fresh approval.

name: printing.checkout.create

checkout.description: Stripe Checkout session created for the approved quote.

title: Create Approved Stripe Checkout
